bank_kyc.name: Bank / KYC Scam
bank_kyc.description: A scam in which someone impersonates a bank, financial institution or service provider and claims that an account, KYC or banking service requires immediate action.
recommended_actions: Do not share OTP, PIN or password.
Do not click a suspicious banking link.
Do not install software at the caller's request.
Open your bank's official app yourself to check for genuine alerts.
Contact the bank through a trusted official channel.
bank_kyc.warning: Banks and legitimate service providers should not require you to disclose confidential authentication secrets to an unsolicited caller.

remote_access.name: Remote Access Scam
remote_access.description: A scam where a fraudster attempts to persuade the victim to install remote-access or screen-sharing software so the fraudster can view or control the device.
indicators: caller wants to guide banking activity remotely
recommended_actions: Do not install remote-access software because of an unsolicited caller.
Do not share your screen.
Do not allow another person to control your device.
Close the suspicious application if one was installed.
If banking information may have been exposed, contact your bank through a trusted channel.
remote_access.warning: Remote access can expose sensitive information and may allow a fraudster to observe or manipulate activity on the device.

digital_arrest.name: Digital Arrest / Impersonation Scam
digital_arrest.description: A social-engineering scam in which criminals impersonate police, courts, government agencies or other authorities and use threats, fear and prolonged communication to control the victim.
indicators: demand for money to avoid legal action
recommended_actions: Stop following the caller's instructions.
Do not transfer money to prove your innocence.
Do not share OTP, PIN or passwords.
Do not allow an unknown caller to control your device.
End the call and independently contact the relevant authority if necessary.
Tell a trusted family member or person you know.
digital_arrest.warning: Threats of arrest or legal consequences are powerful social-engineering techniques. Do not make financial decisions because an unsolicited caller is threatening you.

courier.name: Courier / Parcel Scam
courier.description: A scam involving fake courier, customs, parcel or delivery claims that are used to obtain money or sensitive information.
recommended_actions: Do not pay an unexpected courier or customs demand immediately.
Do not share banking credentials.
Do not install an application requested by the caller.
Verify the shipment independently using a trusted courier channel.
Tell a trusted person if the caller is threatening you.
courier.warning: Unexpected parcel or customs claims can be used to create fear and pressure victims into sending money or sharing personal information.

job.name: Job / Employment Scam
job.description: A scam that promises employment, work-from-home opportunities or recruitment while requesting money, personal information or other risky actions.
recommended_actions: Do not pay an unexpected recruitment or joining fee.
Verify the employer independently.
Do not share banking credentials or OTPs.
Do not install unknown applications for a job interview or verification.
Be cautious of guaranteed income promises.
job.warning: Fraudulent job offers often use attractive income promises and urgency to make victims pay fees or disclose sensitive information.

investment.name: Investment / Trading Scam
investment.description: A scam that promises unusually high or guaranteed returns and attempts to persuade the victim to deposit money into a fraudulent investment platform or account.
indicators: personal account used for investment payment
recommended_actions: Do not transfer money based solely on a caller's investment promise.
Do not trust guaranteed-return claims.
Verify the investment service independently.
Do not install unknown trading applications.
Do not share banking credentials or OTPs.
investment.warning: Guaranteed or unusually high returns combined with pressure to send money are strong warning signs.

prize.name: Prize / Lottery / Reward Scam
prize.description: A scam claiming that the victim has won a prize, lottery, reward or benefit and must first pay money or provide sensitive information.
recommended_actions: Do not pay money to receive an unexpected prize.
Do not share banking credentials.
Do not provide OTP or PIN.
Verify the promotion independently.
Treat unexpected lottery or prize claims with extreme caution.
prize.warning: A demand for payment before releasing an unexpected prize is a common fraud pattern.

payment_qr.name: QR / Payment Request Scam
payment_qr.description: A scam in which a victim is persuaded to scan a QR code, approve a payment request or transfer money under a misleading explanation.
indicators: claim that scanning a QR receives money
request to approve an unknown payment
recommended_actions: Do not scan an unexpected QR code because a caller tells you to.
Remember that approving a UPI payment can send money.
Read the payment screen carefully before approving anything.
Never disclose your UPI PIN to another person.
Cancel an unexpected payment request.
payment_qr.warning: A QR code or payment request should never be trusted simply because someone claims it will help you receive money.
